Name: Stack Split Redux
Author: pepoluan
Description:
[i][b]This is a continuation of the seemingly abandoned [/b][/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/798][b]StackSplitX[/b][/url][b][i] mod.[/i][/b]

[color=#ffff00][b][i]100% of Donation Points received by this mod goes to [/i]Médecins sans Frontières[/b].[/color]

By default, [b]Shift-RightClick[/b] will halve your stack. With this mod, an input box will appear instead, allowing you to put in [i]any[/i] amount you want up to the actual size of the stack (not just 69 or 420).

With this mod you can have custom stacking when:
[list]
[*]Splitting stacks in your inventory
[*]Buying/selling things in the stores
[*]Bartering things with Desert Trader & Island Trader [**]
[*]Crafting items from your inventory/backpack
[*]Crafting items on Workbenches [**]
[*]Cooking on the Stove
[*]... and others!
[/list]
[**] = features NOT available on StackSplitX

Take a look at the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UGVDvPjUDbk]demo video[/url] for ... well ... a demo of this mod's features :D


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#00ffff][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color][/font][/b]

(All these are not available on original StackSplitX)

[list]
[*]Compatibie with[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url][/b] -- allows you to spawn a custom number of items by Shift+RightClick-ing on CJBIS's stack.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Compatible with [color=#d8d8d8][b]Convenient Chests[/b][/color] (version [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-44#post-28711]1.5.2-unofficial.2-borthain[/url]﻿) -- crafting & cooking will see the chests seen by CC.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2545]Remote Fridge Storage[/url]﻿ -- cooking will see all fridges & chests seen by RFS.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Compatible with [color=#d8d8d8][b]Stack Everything[/b][/color]﻿ (version [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-60#post-41713]3.0.3-unofficial.1-strobe[/url]﻿) -- if it has been made stackable, then SSR will see it as stackable as well.
[/list]
This mod is [i]very likely[/i] compatible with other mods as well; please file a bug report (with SMAPI Log) if you think there's an incompatibility issue with other mods not listed above.


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]
[*]Download & extract to Mods directory
[*]Done!

[/list][b]You must [i]delete[/i] the older StackSplitX mod from your Mods directory[/b], or else this mod will refuse to work.


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#00ffff][size=5]Configuration - config.json[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#00ff00][size=4]"DefaultCraftingAmount"[/size][/color][/font] - default value when Shift-RightClick-ing on a crafting/cooking item. Defaults to 1.
[*][color=#00ff00][font=Courier New][size=4]"DefaultShopAmount"[/size][/font][/color] - default value when Shift-RightClick-ing on a shop item. Defaults to 5.
[/list]
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported since v0.13.2, but not required.


[color=#00ffff][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]For Mod Makers: API[/size][/font][/b][/color]
If you create a mod that adds a new menu, but StackSplitX (old mod) doesn't work on that ... SSR (Stack Split Redux) now has an API!

Grab the Interface file [url=https://github.com/pepoluan/StackSplitRedux/blob/main/StackSplit-Redux/IStackSplitReduxAPI.cs]here[/url], use SMAPI to grab the API by following [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Integrations#Using_an_API]this instruction[/url], and then call the API method [color=#00ff00][b][font=Courier New]TryRegisterMenu(typeof(YourCustomMenuClass))[/font][/b][/color]

The method will return [b][font=Courier New][color=#00ff00]true[/color][/font][/b] if registration is successful, or [b][font=Courier New][color=#00ff00]false[/color][/font][/b] if not.
